findings.observation: Examined Sheet 1 (Cover Sheet) with vision tool. The project name displayed prominently at the top center of the sheet is '1700 SOUTH LAMAR'. This name begins with the street address number '1700'. Per CC Submittal Checklist p.2 and 911 Addressing Standards, project names should be descriptive (e.g., 'South Lamar Commons') and not begin with a street address number.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item explicitly identifies this as a deficiency: using '1515 Main St Commons' instead of 'Main St Commons' as an example of what NOT to do. The project name '1700 SOUTH LAMAR' follows the prohibited pattern. However, the checklist marks this item's 'Fail Status' as 'warn' rather than 'fail', indicating this is a warning-level issue rather than a hard failure.
findings.explanation: Project name '1700 SOUTH LAMAR' begins with street address number, violating 911 Addressing Standards naming convention.
findings.resolution: Revise project name to remove the leading street address number. Acceptable alternatives: 'South Lamar Commons', 'Lamar Street Residences', or similar descriptive name per 911 Addressing Standards p.8.

findings.observation: Reviewed site plan sheets to determine the number of buildings. Sheet 13 shows 'PROPOSED BUILDING 1' as a single structure with 133,718 SF footprint. Sheet 14 confirms one main proposed building structure. Sheet 16 data tables show only 'BUILDING 1' in the units breakdown, with 459 total residential units all housed in this single structure. No additional buildings are proposed.
findings.reasoning: This checklist item is conditional: 'If multiple buildings'. Since only one building is proposed, the condition for applying this requirement is not met. Sequential labeling (Bldg 1, Bldg 2, etc.) is only required when multiple buildings exist, per 911 Addressing Standards p.8.
findings.explanation: Only one building proposed; sequential labeling requirement applies only when multiple buildings are present.

findings.observation: Checked Consolidated Site Plan Application (document 584f1bed-eac2-491c-a064-3f7af56c6f32), Section 6: Property Attributes. Line 28 asks 'Is your project on a Hill Country Roadway?' with checkboxes for Yes and No. The 'No' checkbox is marked with [x]. The site is located at 1700 S Lamar Blvd. Per LDC §§ 25-2-1102–1104, Hill Country Roadway Corridor applies only to sites within 1,000 feet of Loop 360, RM 620, RM 2222, RM 2244, or Southwest Parkway. S Lamar Blvd is not one of these roadways.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item is conditional: 'If within Hill Country Roadway Corridor per LDC 25-2-1101--1107'. The application explicitly confirms the project is NOT on a Hill Country Roadway, and the site location on S Lamar Blvd is not within 1,000 feet of any of the five named HCR corridors. The condition is not met, so the requirement does not apply.
findings.explanation: Project is not on a Hill Country Roadway per application; site is on S Lamar Blvd, not within HCR corridor.
